system.description:
When targeted by a Strike that fires projectiles, make a Strange Check with CR equal to the attacker's CR. Match the CR: take half damage (rounded down). Exceed it by 1: take no damage. Exceed it by 2 or more: take no damage and the attacker takes half the attack's damage. Doom +3.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.68
system.summary: When targeted by a Strike that fires projectiles, make a Strange Check with CR equal to the attacker's CR. Match the CR: take half damage (rounded down). Exceed it by 1: take no damage. Exceed it by 2 or more: take no damage and the attacker takes half the attack's damage. Doom +3.

automation.label: CR = the attacker's CR
automation.onSuccess: Exactly the CR: half damage (rounded down). CR +1: no damage. CR +2 or more: no damage and the attacker takes half the attack's damage.

automation.note: Use when a projectile Strike targets you, before damage is applied; adjust the damage by hand from your margin over the CR.
